core_meaning.primary_meaning: Hoorain (حُورِين) is an Arabic-origin female name, the dual form of حُور (ḥūr), referring to the maidens of Paradise described in the Qur'an.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The Arabic dual form حُورِين (ḥūrayn) of حُور (ḥūr), used as a given name.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hoorain is a grammatical dual of the Arabic حُور; it is used as a personal name drawn from the Qur'anic description of Paradise rather than from a lexical definition of its own.

etymology.morphology: Arabic feminine dual form (ḥūrayn) of the plural noun حُور (ḥūr).
etymology.etymological_meaning: From the Arabic root ح و ر (ḥ-w-r); حُور (ḥūr) is the plural noun for the maidens of Paradise, and حُورِين is its dual.
etymology.etymology_explanation: The root ح و ر underlies حُور (ḥūr) and the phrase حُور عِين used in the Qur'an; حُورِين is the dual of that noun, used as a name.
etymology.false_etymology_warning: The name is a dual form of a Qur'anic descriptive noun; any claim of an independent lexical meaning beyond that is unsupported.

faq.a: The Qur'an describes the maidens of Paradise with the noun حُور and the phrase حُور عِين; Hoorain is the dual form of that noun, used as a personal name.
